name: Career Survival v15b: balanced risk-first career ladder
instruction: Load the career-survival skill once and follow it for one 48-month game. Read the public handbook once and create exactly one game; reuse its session_id. Before every decision observe, then take_action with one offered integer choice and a short English note of at most 15 words. Keep only the compact memory the skill describes, including its risk tally; do not use the code tool. Survival overrides growth: risk warnings, low Health, Dignity, Network or Wealth, and weak reviews come first. Pay listed hidden risk back down, avoid spending wealth in stories, and keep all six ending dimensions balanced. Do not assume hidden thresholds. On a timeout, observe and check recent logs before retrying. Every reply during the game must contain a tool call. Continue until an explicit ending_score, print it in full, then print DONE.
